chunks: And with this chain, from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Hariz, who said:

It was asked of Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) regarding fasting on Wednesday, so he said: Ali (peace be upon him) used to say, 'Indeed, Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, created Hell on Wednesday, so he loved fasting on it to seek protection from Allah against the Fire.'
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual significance of fasting on Wednesday according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This narration from Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Thawab al-A'mal* highlights the specific virtue of fasting on Wednesday by linking it to the creation of Hell, a concept rooted in Shia eschatological tradition. Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) attributes this practice to Imam Ali (peace be upon him), who fasted on this day to seek divine protection from the Fire, thereby transforming a day of potential dread into one of spiritual refuge and supplication.

en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 5. And from the previous chain from al-Hussain b. Sa’eed from Hamad b. Isa from Hareez who said:

Imam Ja’far Sadiq (a.s.) was asked regarding fasting on Wednesday. He replied that Ali (a.s.) used to say, “The Almighty Allah created Hell on Wednesday. He likes the person fasting on this day seeking protection against the fire of Hell.”
